move: iOS banner springs onto lock screen with haptic shake, dismisses up
how: A 300x620 phone with an aurora lock screen drifts rotateY 16 -> 9 with sine.inOut over the 3s while a right-aligned three-line headline rises from yPercent 110 (0.08s stagger, expo.out) and kicker/paragraph fade up. At 15% a frosted banner (backdrop-filter blur 30px) drops from y -170, scale 0.9, opacity 0 to rest in 0.8s on a CustomEase iOS spring while the clock nudges y 10; the banner text fades up with 0.06s stagger and the phone body shakes x 0 <-> 3 six times as a haptic. At 78% the banner retreats to y -170, scale 0.92, opacity 0 with power3.in, the clock returns and the copy slides right and fades.
adapt: Replace the app name, message, headline words, the lock-screen image and outer background. Keep the spring CustomEase, the 0.8s drop and the 0.05s x6 haptic.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the phone and copy; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the drop at 0.15D, haptic at 0.167D and dismiss at 0.783D. CustomEase must be registered by the engine; from() tweens should be fromTo with immediateRender:false; el needs perspective:1800px.
caveats: backdrop-filter blur(30px) on the banner over a cover image
full-frame background image with brightness/saturate filter
loop does not close: copy fades and phone angle differs from frame 0
